results.name: Acceleration: 0–100 km/h
results.expected: 2.3–3.8 s (fictional open-wheel target, traction-limited launch with TCS)
results.detects: Torque curve, gearing, launch clutch, TCS and wheel-spin stability errors

results.name: Acceleration: 0–200 km/h and 400 m
results.expected: 0–200 km/h in 5.5–10 s; 400 m time reported
results.detects: Drag/power balance and shift logic

results.name: Acceleration: top speed vs power/drag balance
results.expected: within ±3% of analytic 306.8 km/h
results.detects: Units errors in drag, efficiency, gear ratios or wheel radius

results.name: Acceleration: no speed loss during shifts
results.expected: speed drop per step < 0.25 m/s
results.measured: 0.037 m/s worst
results.detects: Torque spikes or reversed forces at gear changes

results.name: Braking: 200–0 km/h with ABS vs ideal
results.expected: 74.0–96.2 m (ideal = peak grip at average load, an upper bound on deceleration)
results.measured: 78.2 m in 3.17 s, peak 2.64 g, locked-wheel steps above 3 m/s: 0
results.detects: Brake torque, bias, ABS and downforce errors

results.name: Braking: ABS off locks wheels and stops longer
results.expected: lock-ups occur and distance exceeds the ABS run
results.measured: 86.3 m, locked-wheel steps: 373
results.detects: Missing lock-up or post-peak tire behaviour

results.name: Braking: no creep or jitter at standstill
results.expected: after a 0.5 s settle: speed < 0.02 m/s with brake held, and with brake released for 5 s
results.measured: held 0.0000 m/s, released 0.0010 m/s; tire spring-back in the first 0.5 s peaks at 0.351 m/s; guard trips 0
results.detects: Low-speed tire singularities and numerical creep

results.name: Coast-down: recovered drag area
results.expected: CdA within ±5% of 1 m²
results.measured: 0.997 m² from 276 samples
results.detects: Drag formula, density or mass errors

results.name: Coast-down: recovered rolling resistance
results.expected: Crr within ±10% of 0.012
results.detects: Rolling resistance or wheel-torque errors

results.name: Coast-down in vacuum: no aerodynamic drag
results.expected: deceleration independent of speed and ≈ rolling resistance only (0.112 m/s²)
results.measured: vacuum: 0.112 m/s² at 250 km/h, 0.112 m/s² at 90 km/h; with air at 250 km/h: 2.82 m/s²
results.detects: Aero forces that ignore air density

results.name: Constant radius (R = 50 m): limit lateral acceleration
results.expected: 1.57–2.01 g (prediction 1.97 g ignores load-transfer and drive-force losses)
results.measured: 1.75 g (0.5 s filtered, path error < 2 m); path lost at 108.5 km/h
results.detects: Tire peak, load sensitivity and downforce coupling errors

results.name: Constant radius: stable understeer balance
results.expected: understeer gradient ≥ −0.02 °/(m/s²); sideslip < 6° while on the path
results.measured: K = 0.022 °/(m/s²), max sideslip 2.32°
results.detects: Unstable oversteer from weight transfer or sign errors

results.name: Worlds: lower gravity does not add grip (Halcyon Ring 0.7 g)
results.expected: max lateral acceleration lower than on Earth-gravity Lumen Harbor
results.measured: 1.18 g vs 1.75 g (prediction 1.37 g)
results.detects: Grip that ignores normal load

results.name: Slalom (80 km/h, 0.6 Hz, ±2°): bounded, settles
results.expected: peak lateral < 1.2 g; yaw rate < 0.01 rad/s within 2 s after input stops
results.measured: peak 0.52 g, peak yaw rate 0.238 rad/s, settle 0.05 s
results.detects: Under-damped yaw modes or divergence

results.name: Slalom: yaw response lag
results.expected: yaw-rate peak follows steer peak by 0–0.25 s
results.measured: 0.048 s average over 4 peaks
results.detects: Excess tire relaxation or missing transient response

results.name: Curb strike at 150 km/h (right wheels on a 25 mm curb)
results.expected: max compression < 65 mm, loads 0–16 kN (≈4× an aero-loaded corner), heading error < 4°, yaw rate < 0.3 rad/s

results.detects: Excessive impulses, bump-stop explosions, instability on curbs

results.name: Curb at 15 m/s with ridges (band-limited)
results.expected: same limits with ridge vibration active
results.measured: comp 22.7 mm, load 0–4855 N, heading err 0.03°
results.detects: Aliasing or resonance from curb ridges

results.name: Curb changes wheel loads measurably
results.expected: left/right rear load difference larger on the curb than on flat asphalt
results.measured: 129 N vs 1 N
results.detects: Curbs that have no physical effect

results.name: Barrier impact 30° at 150 km/h
results.expected: no energy gain; penetration < 0.05 m from 4 steps after contact; outgoing normal speed ≤ 0.3 × incoming + 1 m/s; yaw rate < 6 rad/s

results.name: Tunneling: head-on at 90 m/s
results.expected: car centre never passes the barrier; penetration < 0.05 m after resolution
results.measured: CG margin 2.15 m inside; peak pen 0.005 m, later 0.005 m
results.detects: Tunneling through thin geometry at high speed

results.name: Low speed: 60 s at rest, no input
results.expected: speed < 0.001 m/s, yaw rate < 1e-4 rad/s, drift < 1 cm
results.measured: speed 0.00e+0 m/s, yaw rate 0.00e+0 rad/s, drift 0.000 mm, yaw drift 0.00e+0 rad

results.name: Low speed: smooth creep with 5% throttle
results.expected: acceleration does not oscillate (≤ 2 sign changes); car moves
results.measured: speed after 6 s 3.82 m/s, sign changes 0, max rear slip 0.004

results.name: Frame-rate independence (30/60/90/144 FPS, jitter)
results.expected: bit-identical final state for every render rate

results.expected: speed within 1%, position within 2 m after a 15 s manoeuvre with ABS/TCS off and no wheelspin or lock-up

results.name: Repeatability (same machine, same inputs)

results.name: Worlds: braking 100–0 km/h
